title: The Necklace
synopsis: A story about a beautiful woman who believes she deserves better.

fullText.simplified:
晚宴的日子越来越近了。
    虽然晚礼服早都准备好了，但贾聪却越来越不开心。
    一天傍晚，她丈夫问她：“聪聪，这些天你总是心事重重的样子，怎么了？”
    贾聪很难过地说：“我花了好长时间终于配好了鞋子，但是我找遍了所有的首饰，都找不到能配得上这套晚礼服的。你说，那么重要的晚宴，别人一定都是珠光宝气的，就我全身一件首饰都没有……这简直是太可笑了。你说，如果被记者们拍到了，会不会就是明天网上的笑话？要是让大家都知道我是晚宴上最穷的人，那真是太没面子了。我决定不去了，要不你把请帖卖了吧！”
    徐来坐在她身边，想了想，说道：“啊……首饰！咱俩结婚时的钻戒就很合适啊！”
    贾聪却觉得钻戒太小不适合那种场合。她不高兴地说道：“那怎么行……你忍心看你的妻子被别人比下去吗？”
    “当然不忍心。”虽然徐来不觉得只戴钻戒会被别人比下去，但还是很认真地帮着妻子想办法。突然，他跳起来说：“我有办法了！你看，连明星们的首饰都是找珠宝商借的，你也可以借呀！你去找你的朋友甄美，跟她借一件。她那么有钱，一定有不少首饰。你俩同学这么多年，这点小事她肯定愿意帮你的！”
    贾聪尖叫起来：“对呀！我怎么没想到呢！”
　第二天，贾聪就到甄美家去了。
　甄美痛快地打开了自己的衣帽间，带着贾聪进去，说：“首饰都在这个柜子里，各种款式应有尽有。你自己挑吧，亲爱的。”
　贾聪被眼前一柜子的珠宝惊呆了。每一件首饰都放在大小合适的格子里，静静地等待着她的挑选。她看着这些宝贝，想着要是有一天自己也能过上这样的生活，那该有多好啊！
    贾聪看了一大圈，觉得件件都好看，却还想看看有没有更好的。于是她问甄美：“你还有没有别的？”
　甄美回答道：“那边有的是，你自己挑吧。我不知道你想要什么样的。”
    贾聪忽然发现了一条钻石项链，美丽的钻石散发着明亮的光。这条钻石项链的款式很简单，却又华丽得刚刚好。她一眼就认定这是最适合她的首饰！
    于是，贾聪忍住尖叫，小心地问：“你能把这条项链借给我吗？我只借这一件首饰就好。”
    甄美看了看，说：“当然可以！你的眼光真好！这条项链可是限量款的，上海一套普通的房子都没有它贵呢！”
　听了甄美的话，贾聪更高兴了。她开心地带着这件宝贝回家了。
fullText.traditional:
晚宴的日子越來越近了。
    雖然晚禮服早都準備好了，但賈聰卻越來越不開心。
    一天傍晚，她丈夫問她：“聰聰，這些天你總是心事重重的樣子，怎麼了？”
    賈聰很難過地說：“我花了好長時間終於配好了鞋子，但是我找遍了所有的首飾，都找不到能配得上這套晚禮服的。你說，那麼重要的晚宴，別人一定都是珠光寶氣的，就我全身一件首飾都沒有……這簡直是太可笑了。你說，如果被記者們拍到了，會不會就是明天網上的笑話？要是讓大家都知道我是晚宴上最窮的人，那真是太沒面子了。我決定不去了，要不你把請帖賣了吧！”
    徐来坐在她身邊，想了想，說道：“啊……首飾！咱倆結婚時的鑽戒就很合適啊！”
    賈聰卻覺得鑽戒太小不適合那種場合。她不高興地說道：“那怎麼行……你忍心看你的妻子被別人比下去嗎？”
    “當然不忍心。”雖然徐来不覺得只戴鑽戒會被別人比下去，但還是很認真地幫著妻子想辦法。突然，他跳起來說：“我有辦法了！你看，連明星們的首飾都是找珠寶商借的，你也可以借呀！你去找你的朋友甄美，跟她借一件。她那麼有錢，一定有不少首飾。你倆同學這麼多年，這點小事她肯定願意幫你的！”
    賈聰尖叫起來：“對呀！我怎麼沒想到呢！”
　第二天，賈聰就到甄美家去了。
　甄美痛快地打開了自己的衣帽間，帶著賈聰進去，說：“首飾都在這個櫃子裡，各種款式應有盡有。你自己挑吧，親愛的。”
　賈聰被眼前一櫃子的珠寶驚呆了。每一件首飾都放在大小合適的格子裡，靜靜地等待著她的挑選。她看著這些寶貝，想著要是有一天自己也能過上這樣的生活，那該有多好啊！
    賈聰看了一大圈，覺得件件都好看，卻還想看看有沒有更好的。於是她問甄美：“你還有沒有別的？”
　甄美回答道：“那邊有的是，你自己挑吧。我不知道你想要什麼樣的。”
    賈聰忽然發現了一條鑽石項鏈，美麗的鑽石散發著明亮的光。這條鑽石項鏈的款式很簡單，卻又華麗得剛剛好。她一眼就認定這是最適合她的首飾！
    於是，賈聰忍住尖叫，小心地問：“你能把這條項鏈借給我嗎？我只借這一件首飾就好。”
    甄美看了看，說：“當然可以！你的眼光真好！這條項鏈可是限量款的，上海一套普通的房子都沒有它貴呢！”
　聽了甄美的話，賈聰更高興了。她開心地帶著這件寶貝回家了。

sentences.traditional: 這條鑽石項鏈的款式很簡單，卻又華麗得剛剛好。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiáo zuàn shí xiàng liàn de kuǎn shì hěn jiǎn dān què yòu huá lì de gāng gāng hǎo
sentences.english: The style of this diamond necklace was quite simple, yet it was gorgeous in just the right way.

sentences.simplified: 她一眼就认定这是最适合她的首饰！
sentences.traditional: 她一眼就認定這是最適合她的首飾！

sentences.english: She took one look and she decided right away that this was the best piece of jewelry for her!

sentences.traditional: “你能把這條項鏈借給我嗎？我只借這一件首飾就好。”

sentences.simplified: 这条项链可是限量款的，上海一套普通的房子都没有它贵呢！”

sentences.english: This necklace is limited edition; a typical house in Shanghai is less expensive than this necklace!”

sentences.simplified: 听了甄美的话，贾聪更高兴了。她开心地带着这件宝贝回家了。
sentences.traditional: 聽了甄美的話，賈聰更高興了。她開心地帶著這件寶貝回家了。

sentence_translations: It was getting closer and closer to the date of the gala.
Though the evening gown had been prepared, Jia Cong had been getting more and more upset.
One evening, her husband asked her, ..
.. “Congcong, you’ve been looking like there’s something on your mind recently. What’s wrong?”
Jia Cong replied sadly, “I spent such a long time to finally find a pair of shoes to match.
But, I’ve looked everywhere for jewelry and still can’t find anything that matches this evening gown.
Think about it, at such an important gala, other people will be wearing splendid jewelry, ..
.. and I’ll be the only one without a single piece of jewelry …
That would be completely ridiculous.
Think about it, if I get photographed by reporters, won’t I become the laughing stock of the internet tomorrow?
If people find out that I’m the poorest person at the gala, I’d be so embarrassed.
I’ve decided to not attend; why don’t you sell the invitation!”
Xu Lai, sitting beside her, thought for a bit and said, ..
.. “Ah, jewelry! The diamond ring from when we got married would be quite fitting!”
But Jia Cong felt that the diamond was too small and thus not appropriate for that type of occasion.
She said unhappily, “How could that be okay … Could you bear to see your wife getting overshadowed by others?”
“Of course I couldn’t.”
Although Xu Lai didn’t think that only wearing a diamond ring would cause her to be overshadowed, ..
.. he still thought hard to help his wife find a solution.
Suddenly, he jumped up and said, ..
..  “I have an idea! Look, even celebrities borrow their jewelry from jewelers. You could also borrow jewelry!
You can go ask your friend Zhen Mei and borrow something from her.
Considering how wealthy she is, she must have a lot of jewelry.
You two have been classmates for so long, surely she’d be willing to help with a little thing like this!”
Jia Cong exclaimed, “You’re right! Why didn’t I think of this!”
The next day, Jia Cong went to Zhen Mei’s house.
Zhen Mei gladly opened her closet and guided Jia Cong inside, saying, ..
.. “All the jewelry is in this cabinet, all sorts of styles, everything. You can pick yourself, darling.
Jia Cong was astounded by the cabinet of jewelry in front of her eyes.
Every piece of jewelry was put into a cubby of the right size, quietly waiting for her to pick.
She looked at these treasures, and thought if one day she could also live this sort of lifestyle, ..
.. how great that would be!
Jia Cong looked around and thought that every piece was beautiful.
Yet, she wanted to see if there was anything even better.
So, she asked Zhen Mei, “Do you have anything else?”
Zhen Mei replied, “There’s plenty more over there. You can pick yourself; I don’t know what type you’re looking for.”
Jia Cong suddenly found a diamond necklace. The stunning diamonds were radiating a bright glow.
The style of this diamond necklace was quite simple, yet it was gorgeous in just the right way.
She took one look and she decided right away that this was the best piece of jewelry for her!
So, Jia Cong held in her screams and asked cautiously, ..
.. “Can you lend this necklace to me? I’ll only need to borrow this one piece of jewelry.”
Zhen Mei took a look and said, “Of course! You have a good eye!
This necklace is limited edition; a typical house in Shanghai is less expensive than this necklace!”
After hearing what Zhen Mei said, Jia Cong felt even happier. She cheerfully went home, treasure in hand.
